name: Toulouse
author: pierreggt
description: Map of the greater Toulouse metropolitan area (France), from Toulouse-Blagnac airport to Muret and from Colomiers to Balma. 245k+ OSM buildings (binary format), 554k+ commuters with demand built from real INSEE census data. Toulouse-Blagnac airport with runways and taxiways. The Garonne river fully modelled with depth data. Protomaps basemap with water, parks and forests.
data_source: INSEE Filosofi 2021 (donnees carroyees, revenus et population) - INSEE Recensement de la population 2021, mobilites professionnelles - OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) - Overture Maps Foundation (buildings)
